reviews.title: Nice app
reviews.text:
UPDATE:  I’m lowering my rating.  It’s not a bad game but the ads have gotten out of control.  And on most of them, when it shows the option to skip the ad, it actually takes you to the App Store for the app in the ad. I’m done with this. 

It's better than some of the other free apps out the. You have ads pop up quite a bit but that's why it's free. The only thing I wish it had was the ability to turn off where it tells you how high your hand is. In a real casino you have to do that on your own and it makes you a bit lazy to that point.

reviews.title: Pretty good….bad dealer
reviews.text:
I used the STRATEGY GUIDE while I played. More times than not, it told me to stand at 15…..17…….13….I lost anyway…. I’d finally get an 18…dealer got 21. Once the dealer had a 17….I had 18…it drew ANOTHER CARD. I thought dealers had to stop when they drew 17?…
Atmosphere was nice. Music was nice….By statically, I won 1/3 of my games…not good enough for me.

reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text:
This app is just ok. There are a a lot of ads, some times every other hand.

 Also, the win/loss ratio is not even close to a real situation.  most runs will be 3-10 losing hands in a row…win 3, lose 5, win 1 lose 10, win 2, lose 7. Just more accurate to real life odds.

reviews.title: Rigged!!!!
reviews.text: Completely unrealistic. The player is already at a disadvantage from the law of math in normal blackjack 52-48 advantage to the dealer. In this game The dealer wins a ridiculous amount. Like 75/25. They beat you incessantly so you buy more chips. But I can’t imagine who would enjoy a game where they consistently lose. Note to the developer. Make the game fair, give the players a chance. They will still lose & buy more chips. But running then over is not enjoyable enough to want to continue playing.

reviews.title: Not a random deal
reviews.text: If you play long enough you see the patterns designed to lure you in then crush you. Hand many many losing streaks up to 12 in a row when betting high or doubling bets. Clever programming but not much fun when you see how it’s rigged to generate revenue. Matters if you watch ads or how long since you started the game. Often get to win the first hand of a session. Never have a winning streak close to a losing streak. Tricked into buying it while trying to close a screen with the x. Still not sure what I hit but suddenly they charged my cc.

reviews.title: New update is absolute garbage
reviews.text:
LOVED this app. I mean it was my go to blackjack practice for years. I’ve played thousands and thousands of hands since buying the ad-free version about 2 years ago.

Today’s update ruins everything that made it great. No longer is it simple practice with no consequences. Now it’s just another trash money scheme to try and get you to buy chips with real life money.

Thanks for the good memories. Will be looking for a new blackjack practice app.
